goal: Prevent wallet assertion crashes and improper transaction abandonment caused by chain state desync during load
Ensure transaction states update only after missing blocks between the wallet and chain tip are rescanned
agreement: Broad concept support for closing a race condition during wallet loading (rkrux, dergoegge, pablomartin4btc)
Verified by testing that the fix resolves the desynchronization issue (shuv-amp, dergoegge)
Unaddressed objection: reverse iteration may not visit child transactions before parents (l0rinc)
Unaddressed objection: the test passes even with the fix reverted, failing to isolate the bug (l0rinc)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it fixes a wallet desynchronization bug that triggers assertion failure node crashes
Prevents confirmed transactions from being erroneously considered eligible for abandonment
